<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/powerbox/bind"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Asks the utility head-end to bind a DataBridge Hub to an AMI meter. A `200` means the request was accepted. Pairing finishes asynchronously, usually within 15 minutes and at most 48 hours. Binding is not idempotent: sending it again for a bound meter returns `400` with `METER_ALREADY_BOUND`.
